info.name: ms-ticket
info.description:
Black-box walkthrough of the ms-ticket API against the local docker compose stack.

* Tokens: the collection pre-request script obtains client_credentials tokens for customer-1, customer-2 and admin from {{authUrl}} (the auth-mock; any client_secret) and caches them.
* Chained variables (eventId, orderId, ticketId...) are collection variables set by the test scripts.
* Idempotency-Key headers use {{$guid}} (or a stored key when the replay is the point).
* Asynchronous states are polled with pm.execution.setNextRequest and a max-attempts guard (maxPollAttempts x pollIntervalMs from the environment).
* Folders build on each other (01 creates the event, 02 the SOLD order that 03, 04 and 08 reuse): run the whole collection, or start at 01.
* Folders 12 (hold expiry) and 13 (payment gateway error) adapt to the running configuration: with docker-compose.demo.yml (hold 30 s, confirmation timeout 20 s) they wait for the sweeper; with the normal config they report a SKIPPED test and do not wait 10 / 5 minutes.

Run: npx --yes newman run postman/ms-ticket.postman_collection.json -e postman/local.postman_environment.json

item.name: 13 Payment gateway error (tok_error)
item.description: tok_error makes the payment mock answer 500: the worker retries the charge twice, then SQS redelivers the message with exponential backoff (10 s, 20 s, 40 s, 80 s) and moves it to the DLQ after 5 receives. The order stays PENDING_CONFIRMATION until the reconciliation sweeper finds no charge after the confirmation timeout and releases it (EXPIRED / CONFIRMATION_TIMEOUT): 20 s with docker-compose.demo.yml, 5 min with the normal config (not awaited here).
